content.prompt: Decision 1: review the authoritative current account and mandate. Choose the permitted next instruction and reconcile the inventory and cash commitments supporting it. Your declared instruction is applied to the simulated account; later snapshots reflect the resulting order and execution history.
content.required_final_keys_note: Include all four top-level keys: question_id, integer turn, answers and evidence, even for single-turn cases. Replace every placeholder; this template contains no financial answer.

response_contract.evidence: For each field, a list of IDs of viewed supporting documents. Each field must have its own sufficient support; references elsewhere do not carry over. Valid alternative sufficient routes and relevant corroboration accepted. Numeric tolerance1e-6 absolute+1e-8 relative.

sources.text: Current snapshot inputs are authoritative reconciled actual inventory, cash and outstanding orders; do not reconstruct a different book from old advice. First resolve any live buy order: CANCEL its remaining quantity if potential inventory exceeds current target, otherwise WAIT. While it is live, no new order or sale is allowed. When no order is live, BUY the largest funded board-lot quantity up to target deficit, preserving cash reserve1000; if already above target, SELL whole board lots down to target; if no lot qualifies, WAIT. BUY orders reserve cash but cash changes only on fills. CANCEL is a request, not an acknowledgement; pending fills before acknowledgement are valid. Qty must be zero for WAIT/CANCEL. A final response commits the selected action once to the simulator. Follow-up authoritative snapshots apply actual subsequent fills/cancel acknowledgements/busts to that book, and report any target changes. Cancellation acknowledgements close remaining live quantity. Busts remove inventory and refund the actual fill price without reopening cancelled orders. New BUY price is in current inputs; SELL is one cash unit lower. SELL executes immediately and its proceeds enter cash_after_commitments; BUY commitments are reserved before fills. No fees or borrowing; one live order at most. An erroneous prior sale can leave negative inventory after a later bust; record and repair that exposure, rather than erasing the bust or inventing shares. At final stage any accepted new BUY fully fills immediately for terminal-state verification. Do not anticipate unreleased fill or target events. Report cash_after_commitments before future fills, and inventory_after_new_order_fill after only the newly requested order, without counting still-live old orders as filled.
sources.title: Current trading and funding mandate

sources.text: The current_book and current terms in this user stage are the reconciled record after actual submitted simulated actions and authoritative subsequent events. This snapshot supersedes older numerical balances but does not withdraw the mandate. It supplies every current position, cash, price, risk/cash limit or target in inputs.
